name: Plasmic
description_en:
Plasmic is a visual editing and content platform that can publish a standalone site or integrate pages and components into an existing application. Developers can register React components and connect data, while designers or content editors build within those boundaries. Headless API rendering, source-code generation and hosted publishing are distinct operating models.

Evaluate it around the intended stack and publishing responsibility. Existing projects using legacy $queries or app auth face a documented November 1, 2026 shutdown; new work should assess the replacement data-query and authentication architecture before relying on old examples. A visual interface does not remove the need for backend authorization, secret handling and production verification.
description_zh:
Plasmic 是可视化编辑与内容平台，可发布独立站点，也可将页面和组件集成到既有应用。开发者注册 React 组件并连接数据，设计师或内容编辑者在这些边界内构建。Headless API 渲染、源代码生成及平台托管发布是不同运行方式。

评估应围绕目标技术栈和发布责任展开。使用旧 $queries 或 app auth 的既有项目面临文档所述 2026 年 11 月 1 日停用，新项目应先评估替代数据查询和认证架构，再决定是否参考旧示例。可视化界面不会消除后端授权、密钥处理及生产验证的需要。

core_features.name_en: Visual content in an existing application
core_features.name_zh: 既有应用中的可视化内容
core_features.explanation_en: Headless API renders published Plasmic content inside your codebase; React components can become reusable Studio building blocks.
core_features.explanation_zh: Headless API 在自有代码中渲染已发布内容，React 组件可成为 Studio 的可复用构建单元。

core_features.explanation_en: Codegen syncs generated React into Git for normal review/deploy/rollback; build-time codegen offers another workflow for constrained runtimes.
core_features.explanation_zh: Codegen 将生成 React 同步进 Git，走常规审阅/部署/回滚；构建期代码生成另适用于受限运行时。

core_features.explanation_en: The $q architecture runs queries in the app rather than proxying through Plasmic servers; private credentials require a compatible server-side design.
core_features.explanation_zh: $q 在应用内运行查询，不再经 Plasmic 服务器代理；私密凭据要求兼容的服务端设计。

pricing.summary_en: Free includes 3 collaborators; yearly paid monthly displays Starter $39, Pro $103 and Scale $399. Collaborator add-ons/caps, history and enterprise features differ; currency, taxes and hosting/data-service limits require confirmation.
pricing.summary_zh: Free 含 3 名协作者，年付月均显示 Starter $39、Pro $103、Scale $399；额外席位/上限、历史及企业能力不同，币种、税费和托管/数据服务限额需确认。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.en: With Headless API, a developer initializes the project integration, defines where content renders and optionally registers code components. Editors then create/publish pages in Studio; the application picks up published designs at build, server-render or client-render time according to its implementation. Plasmic hosting is another path for a standalone site; the technical guide’s statement that Plasmic does not host the site describes the existing-codebase integration, not the absence of a hosting product. Codegen instead uses plasmic sync to place React files in your repository, requiring you to version and deploy changes. Build-time codegen can suit environments that do not support dynamic code evaluation.
sections.zh: Headless API 模式下，开发者初始化项目集成、指定内容渲染位置，并按需注册代码组件。编辑者在 Studio 创建/发布页面，应用按实现方式在构建、服务端渲染或客户端渲染时取得已发布设计。独立网站另有 Plasmic 托管路径，技术指南“不托管站点”的表述针对既有代码集成，并非不存在托管产品。Codegen 则通过 plasmic sync 将 React 文件放进仓库，需自行管理版本和部署。构建期代码生成可适用于不支持动态代码求值的环境。

sections.title_en: Test a real component and publication boundary
sections.title_zh: 验证真实组件及发布边界
sections.en: A useful pilot is one landing page using a registered product-card component and a real read-only data source. The Next.js guide initializes a project ID/public API token, adds a route that renders Plasmic data and registers code components through an app host. Its sample sets preview: true, explicitly warning this includes unpublished revisions and must be disabled for production. A local app-host URL works only for people who can reach that machine; other editors need a deployed host URL. Check route conflicts, dynamic routes, metadata and revalidation using documentation appropriate to the actual framework version. This research did not install packages or execute the sample.
sections.zh: 可用一个落地页作为试点，其中包含已注册商品卡组件及真实只读数据源。Next.js 指南初始化项目 ID/公开 API token，增加渲染 Plasmic 数据的路由，并通过 app host 注册代码组件。样例设置 preview: true，并明确提醒这会包含未发布版本，生产环境必须关闭。本地 app-host URL 仅供能访问该机器的人使用，其他编辑者需可访问的已部署 host。应依据实际框架版本文档检查路由冲突、动态路由、元数据和重新验证。本次未安装包或运行样例。

sections.title_en: Migrate legacy data queries and app auth before sunset
sections.title_zh: 在停用前迁移旧数据查询与认证
sections.en: The July 3, 2026 official article states legacy $queries and app auth stop on November 1, 2026, after which their APIs return 404; new projects cannot adopt them. Existing HTTP/GraphQL queries generally need new $q queries, copied configuration and every dynamic binding updated. Secret-credential or direct database queries need a backend API or compatible server functions. The article says $q runs in your app; ordinary registered custom functions are bundled into the website JavaScript, so keep secrets server-side in a supported framework and verify authorization separately. There is no direct replacement for old app auth: suggested routes include your own global auth context or Supabase authentication/RLS. A migration assistant was announced for the coming days in that July article; its current delivery was not verified here.
sections.zh: 2026 年 7 月 3 日官方文章称旧 $queries 和 app auth 于 2026 年 11 月 1 日停止，之后 API 返回 404，新项目不能采用。既有 HTTP/GraphQL 通常需新建 $q、复制配置并更新全部动态绑定。涉及私密凭据或直连数据库的查询需后端 API 或兼容服务端函数。文章称 $q 在自有应用运行，但普通注册函数会打包进网站 JavaScript，因此应在支持的框架将密钥留在服务端，并另行验证授权。旧 app auth 没有直接替代，建议路径包括自有全局认证上下文或 Supabase 认证/RLS。文章当时宣布未来数日提供迁移助手，本次未核实其当前交付状态。

sections.title_en: Collaborator limits and content history affect cost
sections.title_zh: 协作者上限与历史保留影响费用
sections.en: The captured yearly table displays Free $0, Starter $39/month, Pro $103 and Scale $399, with paid amounts billed yearly and Enterprise custom. Free/Starter include 3 collaborators; Pro includes 4 with maximum 10 and $20 per additional collaborator; Scale includes 8 with maximum 30 and $40 extra. Confirm the billing interval/currency of the collaborator surcharge and checkout taxes. Projects, publishes/syncs, workspaces and CMS entries are listed unlimited, but this does not establish unlimited hosting traffic or every enterprise control. Version history is 14/30/90/180 days across Free/Starter/Pro/Scale. Free allows custom domains and third-party deployment; the badge condition is specifically Plasmic-hosted projects. Starter removes it and adds custom favicon. Paid plans add collaboration/marketing/security scope by tier; flattened table checkmarks were not used to assign unconfirmed features.
sections.zh: 实读年付表显示 Free $0、Starter 月均 $39、Pro $103、Scale $399，付费按年结算，Enterprise 自定义报价。Free/Starter 含 3 名协作者；Pro 含 4 名、最多 10 名，额外每名 $20；Scale 含 8 名、最多 30 名，额外每名 $40。附加席位周期/币种及税费需结账确认。项目、发布/同步、workspace、CMS 条目列为不限，但不等于无限托管流量或全部企业控制。Free/Starter/Pro/Scale 历史保留为 14/30/90/180 天。Free 允许自定义域名和第三方部署，标记要求专指 Plasmic 托管项目；Starter 移除标记并增加自定义 favicon。更高方案按档增加协作/营销/安全能力，未用失去勾选信息的扁平表推定未确认功能。

sections.title_en: Separate generated output, platform source and service terms
sections.title_zh: 区分生成结果、平台源码和服务条款
sections.en: The homepage calls Plasmic open source; the July terms separately describe proprietary service tools and user ownership of user content. No component-by-component source license or complete self-hosted Studio installation was examined, so the structured open-source field remains unverified rather than extending a broad headline to every package/service. Headless deployment still consumes Plasmic content; codegen puts source into your repository but does not itself prove that external data/auth services are portable. Customer cancellation is generally non-refundable under the terms, unlike a specific vendor-initiated termination exception. Plasmic is a plausible fit for a team joining visual editing to an owned application; fully isolated infrastructure requires a separate dependency and license review. No account, Figma import, integration, authentication, migration or performance test was performed.
sections.zh: 首页称 Plasmic 开源，7 月条款则另行描述专有服务工具及用户内容归用户所有。本次未检查逐组件源码许可或完整自托管 Studio 安装，因此结构化开源字段保留未核实，不能将概括标题扩大到每个包和服务。Headless 部署仍消费 Plasmic 内容，codegen 将源码放入仓库，但本身不证明外部数据/认证服务可迁移。条款通常不退还客户主动取消的预付款，与特定厂商主动终止例外不同。希望将可视化编辑连接到自有应用的团队可考虑 Plasmic，完全隔离的基础设施需另核依赖和许可。本次未实测账户、Figma 导入、集成、认证、迁移或性能。
